Subject: Launch day traffic spike — temporary quota ladder request

Markus / Karthik,

Quick context: we have a surprise warehouse-wide promotion that’s going live next week for Nimbus’ pilot region (East Coast). Traffic projection models just moved our expected QPS up ~6x for a 36–48 hour window starting 2028-07-29 00:00 ET. Our infra is fine but we expect to hit the rate limits on Redwood during the hottest hour.

Ask: can Redwood provision a short-duration headroom arrangement (48 hours) with a blended overage cap so we don’t face punitive per-token rates for the spike? Procurement needs an estimate of the overrun cap and billing cadence (will this be invoiced monthly or net-30 after event?). If you have a one-pager or short proposal we can send to our finance team that would be great.

We’re happy to commit to a small prepaid headroom if that lowers the overage rate — want to understand tradeoffs.

Thanks,

Thanks for the heads up, Laura — and congrats on the promotion. We can support a short-window uplift with a few standard packaging options. High level (quick bullets):

- Tiered overrun insurance (48h): 0–20% over baseline = standard overage rate; 20–100% = blended overage rate cap; 100%+ = emergency headroom (one-time elevated rate)
- Prepaid headroom credit option: pay 5% of expected monthly commit as a prepaid pool; if used, we apply a 20% discount to blended overage rates for that window
- Invoice/true-up: default is month-end true-up invoiced net-30; for launches we can issue an interim invoice 3 business days post-window if procurement requires it

I attached a provisional pricing worksheet with an example ladder and simple math. If you can send an estimate of expected token surge (or peak QPS), I’ll run numbers and send a one-page summary you can forward to your finance/procurement team.

Next steps:
- Laura: estimated peak QPS or expected token delta by 2028-07-27 EOD
- Karthik / Ben: confirm the maximum discretionary concession we can offer without GC/finance approval (Ben — tagging you)

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
